MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
The lecture covers the mechanical properties of glass and amorphous materials, including strength, toughness, Griffith crack theory, fracture mechanics, stress corrosion, fatigue, and fracture statistics using Weibull distribution analysis.
